composition_variation: Illustrate an original anime woman of 27 choosing a record inside a bright courtyard cafe with a small vinyl corner. Her refined adult features include clear pale-blue eyes, clean brows, a straight nose, and a thoughtful confident smile. Graphite-gray long hair is swept loosely over one shoulder, with a few soft strands around the ear. Dress her in an opaque cream fine-knit short-sleeved top with a modest jewel neckline, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, and white low-profile shoes. She stands at a waist-high wooden record bin, holding one plain illustrated record sleeve upright against her lower torso while her other hand rests lightly on the bin edge. The sleeve shows only abstract orange and blue shapes, no words or logos. Turn her head slightly as if hearing a pleasant melody from a small distant speaker. Warm timber, a single potted rubber plant, and a low cafe table create a welcoming setting. A tall opening behind her reveals a calm pale-blue sky. Soft side daylight and amber wood reflections give her face dimension. Keep the drawing polished, uncluttered, and naturally expressive. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
